chapter_edits.old: ([record](../results/records/condition-correspondence-discipline.md)) Living on and descent are in [04](04-LIFE.md#r-living-on-and-descent).
chapter_edits.new: ([record](../results/records/condition-correspondence-discipline.md)) Living on and descent are in [04](04-LIFE.md#r-living-on-and-descent). **Theorem** (any process; the relational reading of a run; the separate witness). Read an event of a run (a formation at a step) through its conditions as living where its formation is active then and does not consume in the run, and relate events whose formations take part in a common condition. A condition every living event's formation takes part in connects the whole, and there, given a standpoint and a living event, living significance is exactly a seed with both neutralities (`Conditions.significant_iff_of_common`); two formations active at every step, each depending only on its own condition and drawing nothing, are living and leave the whole unconnected (`Separate.not_connected`), so the reading alone gives no connection. Where a formation consumes, some formation depending on the drawn condition loses its support from some step on, and the two take part in that condition; under relational neutrality a standpoint holding an event of the consumer significant holds significant every living event of that formation (`Conditions.valuing_consumption_reaches`). The transmission runs along co-participation, not through consumption. ([record](../results/records/significance-through-a-common-condition.md))
